description: COY WIRE, CNN 10 ANCHOR: Hello and welcome to the show. I'm Coy Wire. This is CNN 10, your 10 minutes of news, where I tell you the what, letting you decide what to think. We begin in Rome, where they are bracing for a slew of visitors. In less than two weeks, millions of people will flock to the Italian capital for the Jubilee.
